decision.explanation: The provided evidence (pmid-28787259:f01) describes a phase I/II study of 26 patients with relapsed/refractory ALK-positive Anaplastic Large Cell Lymphoma (ALCL) treated with crizotinib. The study reports an objective response rate (ORR) of 90%, with complete response rates of 83% and 80% for the 165 and 280 mg/m2 dose groups, respectively. This high response rate in ALK-positive ALCL supports the predictive value of ALK fusion for sensitivity/response to crizotinib. The claim_roster confirms that the literature claim (literature-01) and the drug claim (drug-01) are supported by the evidence. The pathology and genomics claims are marked as not_applicable because no specific patient-level pathology or genomics data was provided, but the literature evidence is sufficient to support the general predictive claim for the disease and drug combination as stated.

citations.quote: In this phase I/II study, 26 patients with relapsed/refractory ALK-positive ALCL were administered crizotinib orally twice daily in 28-day cycles as a single agent for an indefinite duration. Patients with relapsed ALCL achieved an objective response rate of 90%. The overall response rates for patients with ALCL treated at doses of 165 and 280 mg/m2 were 83% and 90%, respectively. Rates of complete response were 83% and 80% for 165 and 280 mg/m2 dose groups, respectively. The most common grade 3 or 4 adverse event was decreased neutrophil count.
